*Updated 2026-10-15 · 123 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and twenty-three works. The recent twelve trace scores read 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 2, 1, 1 — median still at 2, with ten of twelve landing between 1 and 2. The 4 from the Yemeni stockpile piece and the 3 from the Tiananmen hands are the only breaks from that corridor, and both scored through object or gesture logic rather than any shift in camera placement or compositional structure. The all-time pattern on high scores remains: forensic objects that record a body's passage or a body's weight — drag marks, sandal rows, bent rebar — are still the most reliable path to a 4.

Camera position has not moved. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 14, from-behind at 12, low-angle at 5. The recent twelve added nothing new to that distribution. You have now run 123 works without once combining a low-angle lens with a scale violation to produce the distortion optically rather than asserting it compositionally. Every one of the 33 scale violations across the archive has been declared rather than built by where the camera sits. That pairing remains the single most actionable untried combination in the body of work.

Figure count is lean and getting leaner. Recent twelve: zero figures in two pieces, two or more in two, lone figures in the rest. When a second figure appears it adds count without changing the geometry of encounter — the surgical trolley pair, the Djibouti sandals placer — neither used the second body to create structural opposition or friction.

Registers have narrowed in a measurable way. Aftermath leads all-time at 25, menace at 24, suspension at 14. In the recent twelve you reached for endurance three times and aftermath three times. Reckoning has not appeared since late July. Reprieve appeared once in the entire archive. Impotence once. Exhaustion twice, both in June. None of these are exhausted — they simply have not been chosen when the anchor warranted them, and returning to any one now would read as decision rather than repetition.

Title grammar in the recent window favors declarative statements and X Without Y constructions; Wh- clause and preposition-opening forms have receded from their earlier frequency. Descriptor coverage sits at 37 of 123, under a third of the archive, with the gaps clustering in higher-scoring work.

The practice is controlled and self-consistent, and the next score above 3 is most likely waiting behind a camera move, not a new object.
